sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: New toolbar toggle button (`🚩`, only injected once flag images are actually detected on the page) to hide/show the heavy inline `` flag icons injected by the "More Flags Everywhere" / "Canadian Province Flags Everywhere" companion userscripts — each icon can carry 80-200KB+ of inline base64 SVG, and hiding them avoids the scroll-paint stall large tables can hit as a result. Native MusicBrainz country flags (plain CSS ``, no ``) are unaffected. New `sa_enable_flags_toggle_button` setting (default on).
